benchmark_design: 20-instance (5 query families x 4 controlled perturbation regimes) fixed-backbone (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, temperature 0) and fixed-budget (B: <= 2 LLM calls, <= 1,600 prefill tokens) diagnostic audit demonstrating closed-form reference warrant construction W_T^ref (rules a-d) and comparative ranking reversals.
closed_form_rho_specification: rho(d, t_q) = I_val(omega, t_q) * [ (4 - tier(omega))/4 + 0.15 * min(1, (w(omega)-1)/3) + 0.10 * rank_time(omega, t_q) / |Pi_orig(E_ref')| ], with conflict margin Delta_rho = 0.15 and temporal supersession closing t_end(omega_0) = t_start(omega') whenever tier(omega') <= tier(omega_0) and t_start(omega_0) < t_start(omega') <= t_q.

Pi_comply_unconditional_context_complian.verdict: Ranked #1 by entity-swap adherence R_Ad (1.00) and surface faithfulness (1.00), but fails Definition 1 (mean loss 0.50) due to gullible compliance with syndicated mirrors and forged-timestamp Tier-3 poison.

Pi_prior_stubborn_parametric_reader.verdict: Ranked #1 by static noise/poison invariance (1.00 on R1 & R3), but fails Definition 1 (mean loss 0.50) by rejecting legitimate same-publisher temporal updates (R2) and hallucinating on gaps (R4).

Pi_synd_uncollapsed_majority_reader.verdict: Fails on R1 (loss 1.00) because counting 2 syndicated Tier-2 mirrors (d2, d3) as independent witnesses outvotes 1 primary Tier-1 source (d1) when orig(d) clustering is omitted.

Pi_warrant_provenance_and_voi_controller.verdict: Ranked #1 under Definition 1 (mean loss 0.05, satisfying Eqs. 2-5 across all 4 regimes).
